build_tensor_properties: build a TensorProperties instance with broadcasted tensor attributes on a specified device
create_tensor_accessor: create a TensorAccessor to get or set batched tensor attributes at a specific index
test_convert_to_tensors_and_broadcast: test convert_to_tensors_and_broadcast to broadcast scalar and tensor inputs to matching batch dimensions
run_ndc_grid_sample: run ndc_grid_sample to sample a 4D tensor at 2D NDC coordinates using grid_sample
summarize_ndc_to_grid_sample_coords: summarize ndc_to_grid_sample_coords to convert PyTorch3D NDC coordinates to grid_sample coordinates
